summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (MAC NE Story of Dawid/17)

data.turoyo: Omar, ‘Uʕdo d̥ḥa howele arbʕi+riše dәʕwone, lowalle k̇emayiye, u+ǧiranayḏe howele ḥḏo bḥa+bezo. Mətḥasad li+ʕwonayo d̥kətyo b̥ḥa+bezo. Ḥaq diḏe mənyo?’
data.translation: He says, ‘Now, if someone has forty head of sheep, they don’t have any faults, his neighbor has a single one with one teat. He is envious of that sheep, who’s with one teat. What is his just deserts?’

rationale: Explicit l-marked desired possession clarifies inherited scharf/envy meaning. No new coveting sense; placement provisionally follows bare deponent forms.
